description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2024: Innovations in Cold-formed Steel Design and Construction: Towards Tall, Fast, Dry, Multi-hazard Resilience is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Amanpreet Singh, Johns Hopkins University (jhu.edu). The light weight and ductility offered by cold-formed steel- (CFS) framed building systems aligns precisely with the system resiliency needs in moderate to high seismically active regions. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-h8wt-3f30. Keywords: Cold-formed Steel, Tall Building Systems, Seismic Resilience, Fire Resilience, Functional Recovery, Modular Construction. Published 2024-06-25. Facility named: Six Degree of Freedom Large High-Performance Outdoor Shake Table (LHPOST6) - University of California, San Diego. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
